map.管理药品批号与效期，自动按剩余天数分级预警（近效期/临期/过期），数据保存在本地: Manages drug batch numbers and expiry dates, automatically grading warnings by days remaining (near expiry / urgent / expired), with data stored in the local browser.

map.家庭或药房批量登记药品批号与有效期至，工具按当前日期自动计算剩余天数并分级（正常: For a household or a pharmacy registering drug batch numbers and expiry dates in bulk, the tool computes the days remaining from the current date and grades them (normal / near expiry / urgent / expired).
map.自定义预警阈值（如近效期 180 天、临期紧急 30 天），适配不同管理粒度。: Custom warning thresholds (for example near expiry at 180 days and urgent at 30 days) suit different management granularities.
map.数据保存在本地浏览器，便于随时增删改与盘点，过期药品及时清理避免误用。: Data is stored in the local browser for adding, editing, deleting and stocktaking at any time, so expired drugs are cleared promptly and never used by mistake.
map.剩余天数 = 111 天；默认阈值下 111 ≤ 180 → 近效期（建议优先使: Days remaining = 111 days; under the default threshold, 111 ≤ 180 → near expiry (using it first is recommended). Samples: 200 days left → normal, 100 days → near expiry, 20 days → urgent, −5 days → expired.
map.近效期和临期紧急怎么区分？: How are near expiry and urgent distinguished?
map.默认近效期阈值为 180 天（剩余 ≤180 天提示尽早使用），临期紧急阈值为: By default the near expiry threshold is 180 days (180 days or fewer means use it as soon as possible) and the urgent threshold is 30 days (30 days or fewer must be dealt with immediately). The thresholds can be customized on the page.
map.数据存在哪里、会丢失吗？: Where is the data stored, and can it be lost?
map.数据保存在本机浏览器 localStorage，不上传服务器；更换设备或清理浏览: Data is stored in the browser’s localStorage on this device and is not uploaded to any server; changing device or clearing browser data will lose it, so keep a separate backup of important stock.
